sql: SELECT 'F' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side||'/'||f.action||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity||' fee '||f.fee||' @'||(f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time') d FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.filled_at > now()-interval '2 hours 10 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'O', market_ticker, status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'-')||' '||side||'/'||action||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||left(client_order_id,12)||' '||to_char(created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND (created_at > now()-interval '2 hours 10 minutes' OR status IN ('resting','partial')) UNION ALL SELECT 'P', market_ticker, quantity_fp::text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity_fp FROM positions WHERE captured_at > now()-interval '10 minutes' AND (market_ticker LIKE 'KXYTV%' OR market_ticker LIKE '%MENTION%') ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) p WHERE abs(quantity_fp) > 0.01 ORDER BY 1,2
